tools.name: Image to Relief Generator
tools.summary: Turns a render, photo, height map, or multi-view sheet into a smooth 3D relief for CNC carving, with a live 3D viewer, toolpath preview, tool-reach check, and STL, OBJ, height-map, outline, and contour exports.
tools.whats_new: Flat backgrounds stay flat: the blurs now stop at letter edges, so letters no longer puff up the background between them (new Stop blur at edges setting). Also new: heightmap vs shaded image guidance, with the audio overview updated to match.
